title: chat-server: Space destroy does not cascade to channel Chats/Messages
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L1299 (Space/set destroy): 'Cascades to all channel Chats and their Messages. Hard-deletes all records; no tombstones are retained.' MemoryBackend::destroy_object (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs ~898-930) removes only the Space row; channel Chats, their Messages and ReadPositions remain. Decide whether the cascade is handler logic (spec rule, same for every backend: destroy channel Chats then Messages via backend calls) or backend-canonical; per AGENTS.md spec rules belong in the library. Also check removeChannels (L1283: 'Cascades to all Messages in those channels').
acceptance_criteria: Test quoting L1299: destroy a Space with a channel holding messages; Chat/get and Message/get return notFound for them; /changes reports them destroyed. Same for removeChannels per L1283.
close_reason: Fixed by a598b13e (JMAP-x2gd.59): Space destroy cascades to channel Chats/Messages; tests/space_destroy_cascade.rs quotes draft L1299; removeChannels covered in integration.rs (L1283).
